title: Immunofluorescence of Cultured Cells
protocol: Fix cells in 4% PFA for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Wash cells with PBS (2 times, 5 minutes each).
Permeabilize cells with PBS + 0.1% TritonX-100 for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Wash cells with PBS (2 times, 5 minutes each) at room temperature.
Block cells with 10% serum from the species of secondary antibody for 1 hour at room temperature.
Drain cells and incubate with primary antibody diluted in 5% serum overnight at 4°C.
Wash cells in PBS (3 times, 5 minutes each) at room temperature.
Detect primary antibody with Alexa Fluor secondary antibody diluted 1:400 in 5% serum for 1 hour at room temperature in the dark.
Wash cells in PBS (3 times, 5 minutes each) at room temperature.
Add mounting media with DAPI and apply coverslip.
Store slides in the dark at 4°C.
